description: This file contains utility functions for sorting system files such as '/etc/passwd' and related shadow and group files based on numeric IDs, as well as removing backup files for security and consistency within a Linux root filesystem context.

methods.name: sort_file(filename, mapping)
methods.description: Sorts a passwd or group file based on the numeric ID in the third column, optionally remapping names via a provided dictionary.

methods.name: remove_backup(filename)
methods.description: Removes the backup file associated with a given filename if it exists.

methods.name: sort_passwd(sysconfdir)
methods.description: Sorts passwd, shadow, group, and gshadow files in a specified sysconfdir, removing their backups beforehand, and sorts the files by user/group ID.
